question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a blue present, Bob has a grey present, and Claire has a black present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Finally, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Bob has the
Options:
(A) blue present
(B) grey present
(C) black present
solution:
Present colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire):
Initial: (blue, grey, black)
1. Bob and Alice swap: (grey, blue, black)
2. Claire and Alice swap: (black, blue, grey)
3. Claire and Alice swap: (grey, blue, black)
Bob has the blue present, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
